author: ImRaging
body:
Nebula DTM Map: QuatorDownload: http://www.mediafire.com/download/yy37sojxg9ddkvi/Quator.zipMap YML: NoneMap Screenshots: 1) http://gyazo.com/9bac3466b4ce3a902ad88b74b683967e2) http://gyazo.com/3aad1dde99c6d3868db988bac46002293) http://gyazo.com/10ecf63d7129ed73ca2e228faf0d989dCreators: RagingLumberjack, CrixdelloI was also wondering if it would be possible to make it so the first team to break
two monuments wins. I wasn't sure if it would work, but I made the map DTM anyway.
If it is not possible to do this, it can easily be adapted to a TDM map, simply by
removing the monuments (like most maps). In this map I haven't added resources; iron and diamond, to really show the PvP aspect of Nebula. The hotbar setup and items within the inventory would include:Hotbar Slot 1: Stone SwordHotbar Slot 2: Diamond PickaxeHotbar Slot 3: 64 Oak Wood LogsHotbar Slot 4: 3 Golden ApplesHotbar Slot 5: EmptyHotbar Slot 6: 32 Golden CarrotsHotbar Slot 7: 10 ArrowsHotbar Slot 8: 64 Stonebrick BlocksHotbar Slot 9: Point Shop (Nether Star)Armour Slot 1: Leather Cap (Colour differs for each team)Armour Slot 2: Leather Tunic (Colour differs for each team)Armour Slot 3: Leather Trousers/Pants (Colour differs for each team)Armour Slot 4: Leather Boots (Colour differs for each team)
In each of the chests in the middle there is: a bow, 4x64 arrows. The reason
that I have put bows in the middle and not in the players' inventory is because
in this map it would be incredibly easy to shoot people off when building to the middle. This
would create pretty easy and boring gameplay which would not be fun. However, there is always
a spare spot in the players inventory that could be used as a slot for a bow. To finish off, there are
some secret (but fairly obvious) chests which contain full chain armour and a Potion of Swiftness 1,
lasting 2 minutes 15 seconds.
Thank you, RagingLumberjack.

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Similar to a current Avicus map. Make sure that you keep your maps unique.
→ Amount of islands. You have four small and detail lacking islands. 
→  Lack of effort. This map looks like you put little effort into it and it was rushed. Take your time when making maps. 
→ Currently, Avicus does not support 4 teamed DTM, so this wouldn't quite work out.
